headline: The Skubal losers are scattering: Toronto went back to shopping for bats, San Diego is all-in on King, and the Mets kept spending with Goldschmidt.

news.title: Cubs have had 'extensive talks' with Freddy Peralta
news.note: Bob Nightengale says the Cubs want one or two free-agent starters before the lockout and have strong interest in Kaima Taira. He also hears a Logan Webb trade is doubtful before Dec. 1.

news.title: Blue Jays interested in Trevor Rogers and Freddy Peralta
news.note: Sportsnet's Ben Nicholson-Smith adds Rogers and Peralta to a Toronto list that already had King and Taira. The Athletic's Mitch Bannon says the lineup is still the Jays' first priority.

news.title: Mets sign Paul Goldschmidt: one year, $8 million
news.note: A day after Skubal, the Mets added the 39-year-old as a platoon bat. He hit .299/.393/.573 against lefties in 2026.

news.title: Yankees sign lefty reliever Brent Suter
news.note: One year, $4 million with a 2028 club option, per ESPN's Jeff Passan. It may take New York out on Adrian Morejon, the top reliever left.

news.title: Sato could sign 'very well before Thanksgiving'
news.note: Ken Rosenthal's read; Mark Feinsand names the Yankees, Phillies and Blue Jays as frontrunners. MLB won't extend posting windows, so Dec. 1 is a hard deadline for Sato, Taira and Itoh.

news.title: Skubal agrees with Mets: nine years, $450 million
news.note: The two-time Cy Young winner picked the Mets over the Dodgers, Blue Jays and Padres. It's the richest pitcher contract ever, $125M more than Yamamoto's.
